content.text:
CI on main is passing again, and I released v0.29.1.

**CI fix:** The `check` workflow on commit `f3e3af5` failed on one oxlint error at `src/rules.ts:1066`: it wanted a blank line before `const env = ...`. I added that one blank line and committed it as `style(rules): …`. Locally, oxlint, `tsc --noEmit`, `ruff format --check`, `ruff check` and `check_no_comments.py` all passed. CI run `37014452876` on main then passed.

**Release:** I released 0.29.1 rather than 0.29.0. Commit `f3e3af5` had already set `plugin.json` to 0.29.1, and the release script rejects any lower version. It moved the `[Unreleased]` changelog notes into a 0.29.1 section, then tagged, pushed, and published the GitHub release: https://github.com/0x7067/claude-jev/releases/tag/v0.29.1

**Status:** `git status -sb` shows `main` even with `origin/main`. I did not wait for CI to finish on the release commit itself.
